sceneConcept: A tall stately forty-five-year-old Japanese society leader stands alone against a transparent background. Black hair touched by narrow silver streaks is arranged in an immaculate severe bun. Her brown eyes meet the viewer with quiet, precisely measured attention. A long structured black western overcoat falls over a plain solid ash-grey kimono secured by a dark plum obi, with understated black shoes. Her own hands rest together at the waist. Soft even frontal studio light keeps the palette austere and contemporary. Visual refresh: a formal black kimono beneath a severe long coat with one restrained metal ornament.
